reviewSamples.author: debra feniello
reviewSamples.text: Jason and his crew did an excellent job at my home this morning! I highly recommend them for all your outdoor needs. He walked with me when we were done to make sure that everything was completed to my satisfaction!

reviewSamples.author: Angie Wrench
reviewSamples.text: They where the first to respond to our need for a tree trim, and quoted us a reasonable price. They showed up early, and they didn't waste anytime. They made sure we were happy with the job, and the clean up afterwards was very good. We look to using your services again in the near future. Thank you!

reviewSamples.author: Bri White
reviewSamples.text: J&L was the only company who responded when I called down the list of Google names. Then, I posted on a Facebook group as good measure and their name came up again. They helped remove an oak tree that had rotted and fallen on the power line to my brother's home. 10/10 will call again in the future.

reviewSamples.author: Carol Michel
reviewSamples.text: We needed an Oak Tree trim and also cut off 2 palms and the service was really good and reasonable price. Thanks Jason and his crew for all!
